speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) will continue to enhance our education system so that Singaporeans can flourish at every stage of their lives and reach their fullest potential, regardless of starting point.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will equip and empower Singaporeans to learn for life and thrive in an artificial intelligence (AI)- transformed future.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: To nurture appreciation and respect, we will ensure schools remain open to students from all backgrounds and create more opportunities for interaction.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will do more to support children from families with complex needs.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will help students with SEN to transition smoothly into employment or community pathways after completing their education.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: MOE will equip learners and educators to thrive in this new future.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Students in our schools and Institutes of Higher Learning will learn how to use AI responsibly and acquire the competencies needed for an AI-driven workplace.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Guidelines have been put in place to ensure that AI enhances, rather than compromises, learning.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also equip students with critical skills such as problem solving, critical thinking and interpersonal skills, so that they can create value beyond AI.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Educators will be trained to use AI meaningfully and guide students effectively.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: MOE will strengthen the quality and industry relevance of training, expand upskilling and re-skilling pathways, and uplift the professional standards of adult educators to support lifelong learning.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This year marks the tenth anniversary of SkillsFuture.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: To take it further, we need a whole-of-society effort: (a) individuals taking charge of their learning; (b) employers helping workers build industry-relevant skills; and (c) training providers updating curricula and courses to meet industry needs.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will support our teachers, school administrators and allied educators, to deliver good quality education which brings out the best in our students.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will build on the Guidelines for School-Home Partnerships and the Parenting for Wellness initiative to strengthen how parents and teachers work together to support our children’s mental health and emotional resilience, especially in the digital age.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Together with Singaporeans, MOE will equip every citizen with the knowledge and skills to reach their fullest potential.
